definitionZh: *-moz-range-thumb CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展词,代表输入类型="范围"的拇指(即虚拟knob). 用户可以沿着输入的音轨移动拇指,以改变其数值.
sourceDefinition: The ::-moz-range-thumb CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the thumb (i.e., virtual knob) of an input of type="range". The user can move the thumb along the input's track to alter its numerical value.
